name: Content Delivery
description: Deliver each entity's bundled artifact to a configured endpoint. Generic transport: the code knows HTTP verbs, payload assembly, and header interpolation — not any specific destination. Destinations (a webhook, a CMS, …) are provider config a template supplies. No providers configured = nothing delivered, with a loud message.
usage_notes: Configure one or more providers. Each provider: { id, name, type:'json_post', endpoint, method:'POST', headers?, source_field?:'final_json', envelope? }. Secrets go in `headers` as {env:VAR} tokens (e.g. {"X-Delivery-Secret": "{env:DELIVERY_WEBHOOK_SECRET}"}) — never literal keys; auth 'none' = omit `headers`. The `endpoint` also supports {env:VAR}. A provider referencing an unset env var is skipped with a warning. Empty `providers` = no delivery.

options.name: providers
options.label: Delivery providers
options.description: JSON array of provider configs. Each: { id, name, type:'json_post', endpoint (URL or {env:VAR}), method:'POST', headers?:{ Name:'{env:VAR}' }, source_field?:'final_json', envelope?:true }. See README for the schema and the webhook example.
